svg.title: The First Shift: six mission blockouts
svg.desc: Top-down spatial briefs for Mill 04, the feed mill, pump station, freight yard, dormitory and radio relay. Solid rectangles are cover; outlines are rooms. Suggested routes assume usable doors and require runtime validation. S marks spawn, E extraction, numbered circles required objectives and small diamonds story details.
